meta.method: One row is one person. A year counts when they held the job for most of it. The score is real growth against Spain, minus half the rise in the debt ratio, minus school leaving, minus the care queue, minus surgical waits with ten days counted as one point. A missing service figure uses the worst measured change. Four counted years are required, and the community has to be in the debt series. Current-price GDP, GDP per person, population, and jobs are shown beside the score and do not change it.
